base_style: Hand-drawn dark fantasy/horror comic illustration. Bold black ink linework with heavy cross-hatching, stippling, and solid black shadows for depth and grit. Semi-realistic proportions with exaggerated, highly expressive faces and dynamic body language. Rough, textured inked look with visible brush/pen energy. Aged parchment paper background with subtle staining, fiber texture, and irregular torn/worn edges framing the entire page. High-contrast lighting with deep shadows and selective highlights.
characters: Stylized human figures rendered with strong silhouettes, detailed clothing folds and fabric weight, expressive wide eyes and open mouths conveying emotion (fear, determination, panic). Clothing has a medieval/fantasy-adventurer feel with cloaks, layered tunics, and practical gear. Magical or supernatural elements glow softly against the darker tones.
color_palette: Muted, desaturated earthy and atmospheric tones: deep browns, ochres, warm grays, dusty purples, and dark greens. Selective high-saturation accents for key elements (bright reds, luminous greens for magic, sharp yellows). Overall warm but oppressive and shadowy palette with strong value contrast. Parchment base is aged yellow-tan.
layout_and_composition: Standard multi-panel comic page (typically 2×3 or similar irregular grid). Black-bordered panels of varying sizes and shapes, some with slight perspective tilt for dynamism. Mix of tight close-ups on faces/reactions and wider action shots. Full-page composition sits on a textured parchment field with a thin dark outer border. Action flows left-to-right, top-to-bottom with strong panel-to-panel continuity.
lettering_and_dialog: Classic comic speech balloons: white fill, thin-to-medium black outline, pointed tails directed at speakers. Dialogue set in clean, slightly condensed comic lettering (mixed case, readable at small sizes). Emphasis via bold or all-caps words. Sound effects are large, jagged, hand-drawn display lettering integrated into the art with motion or impact energy, often spanning panels or overlapping action.
text_rendering_guide: Dialogue: Clean mixed-case comic font inside white balloons with black borders and tails. Captions: None or rare rectangular boxes if needed. Voice Over: Not used. Chyrons: Not used. Sound Effects: Large, irregular, high-energy hand-lettered text (often with asterisks or elongated vowels) that interacts with the illustration and panel borders.
